root_causes: shallow checkout omitted the frozen base commit needed for ancestry verification
manual base64 transport produced a nonmatching reconstructed ZIP
repository Git LFS rules transformed a directly committed .zip path into a checkout pointer mismatch
replacement: Store the exact package and executor as ordinary-text base64 chunks, verify every aggregate byte count and SHA-256, decode only on the runner, and verify the decoded package and executor before any artifact, model, or label access.
